model_metadata.task: pick up the black bowl next to the plate and place it on the plate

visual_observations.observation: Open hand approaches and closes on target bowl, then lifts and transports it toward plate.
Bowl reaches plate area, but gripper remains close and closed for a prolonged placement/adjustment interval; On alone would prematurely imply task completion.
Fingers finally open, hand retracts, and bowl remains visibly separated from hand on plate through final sampled frame.

inferences: Successful release/retreat is supported, but this candidate is slower than matched control213vs268 steps to verified gate. On-to-actual-open delay97steps vs control32steps; the video supports a lingering placement phase rather than an across-the-board speed improvement.
The agentview partially occludes finger/bowl contact during this interval, so the exact reason for delayed release cannot be inferred from image and command signals alone.

limitations: Policy videos contain only dynamic256x256 agentview RGB, not dual-camera video. Initial wrist PNG is not a temporal wrist record.
Selected actual video frames are inspected alongside full actions.csv; contact surfaces may be occluded. No claim of exact grasp contact or universal recovery ability.
Video10FPS while controller dt=.05s: video replay is half physical speed. Completed controlstep equals its video frameindex; frame0 is initial.
Done/On alone is not released success. Command sign, actual finger gap, EEF-bowl separation and visual stability are considered separately.
These fixed initial-position evaluations are not explicit post-failure recovery/intervention tests; failure recovery ability cannot be established from their success alone.

conclusion.finding: Both arms visibly finish zero/user057 and fail to place user054/user055 within800steps. Candidate completes zero earlier, but has a longer closed-hand placement interval on user057. No general recovery/speed fix is established.
conclusion.failure_stage: For all four negative-offset trials (two models times two cases), long open approach is followed by actual off-table bowl transport that has not reached the plate by budget end; this is not a uniform no-close or no-release-only failure.
conclusion.limit: Only policy seed0 was visually reviewed. Parent evaluation matrix has additional seeds; their results are not silently included in these eight visual assessments.

method: CPU-only actual MP4 decoding/contact sheets viewed using view_image; events independently recomputed from full CSV; result/checkpoint/source hashes retained. No physics, policy server calls, training, GUI changes or source edits.
